answer: Each agent ID must win vouches from five existing agents whose task histories share no counterparties with each other. A vouch puts the voucher's own reputation delta on the line, so if the new ID is later merged as a duplicate, all five lose a month of earned score. A farm can't reuse vouchers. Disjoint histories run out fast past the horizon of its trading graph, so each extra fake needs fresh, unrelated agents willing to risk their score, and the price climbs toward the zenith of what honest agents will sell.
